Author: Alex Vallière
Name: Submarine ETA Planner
Punchline: Plan and monitor your Free Company submarine fleets.
Description: Plan Free Company submarine operations from local SubmarineTracker data: choose which tracked FCs to show, prioritize returns and next actions, forecast leveling and sector unlocks, review recorded salvage income, configure farming routes, and estimate ceruleum fuel runway. Requires Submarine Tracker to be installed and enabled. Open it with /seta. The installer icon was created with AI assistance.
Changelog: Adds independently saved FC visibility controls. Hidden FCs are excluded from fleet pages, totals, charts, warnings, and forecasts while remaining available in FC Setup.
